title: Tenali Rama and the Brinjal Curry
moral: Quick thinking can save you from trouble.

scenes.summary: The king enjoys a special brinjal curry.
scenes.text: The king tasted a delicious brinjal curry and loved it very much.
scenes.image_prompt: king enjoying brinjal curry in royal dining hall cartoon style

scenes.summary: Tenali secretly takes brinjals from the garden.
scenes.text: Tenali took some brinjals from the royal garden at night.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali sneaking into garden and picking brinjals cartoon

scenes.summary: The king looks for the thief.
scenes.text: The king noticed missing brinjals and ordered a search for the thief.
scenes.image_prompt: angry king questioning people in court cartoon

scenes.summary: Tenali prepares his son with a clever answer.
scenes.text: Tenali told his son to say he ate brinjal curry in the rain.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali whispering to his son at home cartoon

scenes.summary: The boy’s confusing answer saves Tenali.
scenes.text: The boy mentioned rain, which had not happened, confusing the king. The matter was dismissed.
scenes.image_prompt: king looking confused while boy speaks and Tenali smiles cartoon

story: The king loved brinjal curry. Tenali secretly took brinjals from the royal garden. When the king searched for the thief, Tenali prepared his son to give a confusing answer. The boy mentioned rain that never happened, and the king dismissed the case.
